limitations: Bounded quant-stratified unique-offset sample, not full-trace replay, temporal routing, GPU demand or trace-frequency-weighted coverage. Quant labels/layout come from the joined CSV; GGUF magic/version and bounds are checked, not tensor metadata or payload identity. DONTNEED is best effort, including covering boundary pages; dirty/pinned pages may remain. mincore PROT_NONE snapshots do not fault payload and are non-atomic, not continuous cache guarantees. read_bytes is process-accounted storage including readahead, not device-isolated traffic. Effective buffered rates include preadv/copies/Python, not physical hardware or RAM/GEMM rates. Quant pairs run serially; summed timings exclude setup/observations and are not wall time. Total residency sums per-quant page occurrences (cross-quant boundary pages may repeat). No concurrent model edits/ownership changes supported; stat checks cannot prove content identity.
